entries.title: Migration waits too long for table lock
entries.root_cause: The migration adding an index to ledger_entries cannot acquire a table lock within PostgreSQL's lock_timeout while a concurrent transaction holds a conflicting lock. Shorten or schedule the competing transaction so the migration can acquire its lock.

entries.title: Ledger index migration lock timeout
entries.root_cause: The migration adding an index to ledger_entries cannot acquire a table lock within PostgreSQL's lock_timeout while a concurrent transaction holds a conflicting lock. Shorten or schedule the competing transaction so the migration can acquire its lock.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run has a different runner image version, checkout, and preceding migration, but times out on the same index creation.

entries.title: Migration transaction deadlocks on balances
entries.root_cause: The balance backfill and a concurrent transaction acquire conflicting locks in an order that creates a PostgreSQL deadlock. Make the transactions acquire their locks in a consistent order.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same migration command fails with a PostgreSQL concurrency error, but this is a deadlock in a balance backfill, not a lock timeout creating an index.

entries.title: Balance backfill deadlock recurs
entries.root_cause: The balance backfill and a concurrent transaction acquire conflicting locks in an order that creates a PostgreSQL deadlock. Make the transactions acquire their locks in a consistent order.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A different run and transaction pair deadlock in the same balance backfill, after a different preceding migration.
